mentions.name: Izeria
mentions.description: A GPS-based discovery app for rediscovering your local area: it surfaces places of interest (like castles and churches) nearby or anywhere in the world, invites users to visit them in person, check in on location, read about the place, and take a fun quiz.
mentions.source_excerpt:
A micro discovery / rediscover your  local area.

My friend dumbed it "Pokemon go but replace the Pokemons with castles and churches :)"

Use the GPS to discover places of interest in your neighbours or anywhere in the world and invites you to do see these places in person and check in and read the page and get a fun quiz.
